PushMessages.title: Push messages
PushMessages.hint: Event drafts wait for approval (unless the publisher is trusted). Broadcasts are approved on create. The worker sends approved messages at send time.
PushMessages.empty: There are no push messages yet.
PushMessages.audienceAreaAndTag: Saved area and a matching tag
PushMessages.eventAudienceArea: Everyone whose saved notify area covers the event. People who follow the publisher are included too.
PushMessages.eventAudienceAreaAndTag: People whose covering area has a tag in common with the event. People who follow the publisher are included too.
PushMessages.eventHint: The notification is approved when you schedule it. The worker delivers it at the chosen time, or on the next tick if you leave the time empty. You can schedule more than one for the same event.
PushMessages.planFullHint: 1 week before, 1 day before, and 1 hour before
PushMessages.planLead: Single is selected to start. Choosing a plan replaces the list. Notifications are created and scheduled only when you approve the plan.
PushMessages.planSendAtHint: Shown in the event timezone. Pick a preset or set a custom time.
PushMessages.planSaved: Notifications saved. They stay in review until the event is published.
PushMessages.planHeld: These notifications stay in review until the event is published. They are not sent before then.
PushMessages.heldUntilPublished: In review until the event is published
PushMessages.planEmpty: Add at least one notification before approving.
PushMessages.planIncomplete: Each notification needs a Swedish and English title and body.
PushMessages.planInvalidTime: Each notification needs a valid send time.
PushMessages.planPast: Each notification must be scheduled in the future.
PushMessages.startChanged: The event start changed. Rebuild the plan so the send times match.
PushMessages.scheduledEmpty: No notifications are waiting to send.
PushMessages.eventDraftExists: This event already has an open notification. Edit that one from the push list.
PushMessages.eventNotPublished: Cancelled and ended events cannot be notified.
PushMessages.eventSendAtHint: Leave empty to send on the next worker tick. Nearby matching still requires the event to stay published.
PushMessages.broadcastHint: Send to everyone, or only users who saved a tag on an area. Created broadcasts are approved and send at the scheduled time (or on the next worker tick).
PushMessages.audienceTagHint: Users who have this tag on a saved area.
PushMessages.broadcastSendAtHint: Leave empty to send on the next worker tick.
PushMessages.sendAtHint: Leave empty to send as soon as approved and the event is published.
PushMessages.audienceHint: Estimate at send time. Audience can change before delivery.
PushMessages.notPublished: Nearby is 0 until the event is published.
PushMessages.capped: Match hit the audience cap; real delivery may include more after a later run.
PushMessages.aggregateNote: Some recipients may see this in a combined alert if they have another push due within 10 minutes.
